Method, assumptions & limits
01 / Exact numerical contract

Weekly rate = sum(freight) / sum(tonnes × kilometres). History = arithmetic mean of available weekly rates in the preceding eight calendar weeks, excluding the current week. Peers = arithmetic mean of other route rates in the same type and week.

02 / Conservative evidence

Sparse TF-IDF retrieval ranks all notes. Route, date, adverse effect, and stated magnitude gates decide eligibility. Unknown-duration notes may justify only their onset week.

03 / Honest limits

No anomaly ground truth was supplied. Thresholds are policy, not trained probabilities. Evidence supports a plausible explanation, not causal proof. Excess spend is a baseline difference, not guaranteed savings. The browser Q&A supports route, month/year, and verdict filters; optional local-model parsing is available via CLI.

FreightWatch 1.0 · No external scripts, tracking, API keys, or network calls · Counts reflect this input snapshot.
